inspection.title: Inspection
inspection.locationUnavailable: Location unavailable. The inspection can still be recorded.
inspection.mockLocation: This device reported a simulated location. Recorded as such.
inspection.noExtraction: The extraction layer did not return this field for this package.
inspection.evidenceGapTitle: The image, its crops and OCR boxes are not served back through the API
inspection.evidenceGapBody: What is shown on this page is the engine's record: per-panel hash, geometry, rectification diagnostics, OCR text, mean confidence and the scale reference. The pixel data, the bounding-box polygons and the field crops are not returned to the portal, by design — the engine measures the original and the report carries the numbers, not the picture. To inspect the original photograph, the field app carries it on the device that captured it.
inspection.docsHint: The same files a printed report would carry: declaration details, finding rows, evidence metadata, the officer's note and the audit chain head at the time the document was generated.
inspection.auditEmpty: No entries have been written for this inspection yet.

gap.title: About the filters on this screen
gap.body: The endpoint behind this list takes date range, store, inspector and rule version. Manufacturer, brand, product, violation type and city are applied here, on the response the server gave, because the live router does not accept them as parameters yet — the gap is named so the filter is not silently partial.

repeatOffenders.title: Repeat offender tracking
repeatOffenders.subtitle: Manufacturers, brands and shops with breaches across more than one visit. The threshold is three distinct shops in the period shown.

list.title: Repeat offenders
list.caption: One row per manufacturer that has breached the threshold. Click a row to open its full history.
list.empty: No manufacturer crosses the three-store threshold in the current period.

history.noHistory: No history in the current filter window.

admin.topNotAssessedCaption: A check high on this list usually points at capture conditions, not at the shops.
admin.violationCategoriesCaption: The seven categories an officer has to act on, with their failing-finding count.
admin.areaWiseCaption: Which jurisdictions carry the most findings, ranked. A spike here is a sign to redeploy officers, not a sign to lower the bar.
admin.brandPatternsCaption: Manufacturer → brand → product chains that have failed in this period. The chains are clickable; the dashboard does not invent routes for them yet.
admin.repeatOffenderCaption: Manufacturers with violations in three or more distinct shops. The full list lives on the Violations screen.
admin.dataNotAvailable: Data not yet available from backend
admin.dataNotAvailableBody: This rollup is on the dashboard's roadmap; the endpoint does not return it yet. The screen states the gap rather than drawing a plausible axis.
admin.todaysReportScopeNote: The /reports/today endpoint is scoped to the caller's account on the server. The six KPI cards above are office-wide; the figures below are the signed-in administrator's own day. The same date picker is offered as on the inspector's report screen.
